name: Advanced Web Ranking
description_en:
Advanced Web Ranking (AWR) is a hosted SEO rank tracker that combines configured search checks, SERP analysis, competitor comparisons, dashboards and reports. AI Search extends the tracked panel to AI answers; Brand Intelligence separately explores the topics, brands and sources associated with a business. Integrations and a remote MCP server can carry AWR data into reporting or AI workflows, subject to plan access.

It is a candidate for agencies or in-house teams that need several markets and client projects with controllable collection schedules. The important evaluation follows a configured project through its resource reservation, completed update and shared report. Keyword units are not simply the number of unique phrases, a started job is not finished data, and public report interaction differs from staff editing. This research reviews public originals without subscribing, connecting Google data, collecting customer rankings or measuring forecast/AI accuracy.
description_zh:
Advanced Web Ranking（AWR）是托管 SEO 排名跟踪器，结合按配置搜索检查、SERP 分析、竞品比较、仪表盘及报告。AI Search 将跟踪面板扩展到 AI 回答，Brand Intelligence 则独立探索业务相关主题、品牌及来源。集成与远程 MCP 可将 AWR 数据用于报告或 AI 流程，受档位访问限制。

它可供需要多个市场／客户项目及可控采集周期的机构或站内团队评估。关键是跟踪配置项目的资源预留、更新完成及报告分享。关键词单位不是简单唯一词数，启动任务不等于数据完成，公开报告交互也不同于员工编辑。本研究核公开原文，未订阅、连接 Google 数据、采集客户排名或测预测／AI 准确性。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Current cards show Pro $139/month (7,000), Agency $279 (14,500), Enterprise $699 (35,500), Ent Plus 50K $980 (50,000); capacity must be read through keyword-unit rules, not unique daily phrases. Annual advertises 10% saving; no annual total/currency code inferred. Seven-day no-card trial, thirty-day money-back request; tax extra. Unlimited projects/users. Agency adds API, custom dashboards and fast updates; annual entitlements differ. Over-limit terms are not fetched without manual upgrade. Cancellation FAQ states functions stop at paid-period end, login after another thirty days, complete data deletion after ninety days; exact account timeline not operated.

official_check.scope: Official public documentation only; no purchase, account operation, sending test, identity or publication approval.

review_notes: Original English and corresponding Chinese research draft. Vendor statements describe documented behavior, not independently measured quality.
Existing third-party source is discovery-only and superseded. Unknown UI languages, regional availability and licensing remain unknown.
All publication and alternative-relationship states remain unapproved.

sections.title_en: Project country and query location have different jobs
sections.title_zh: 项目国家与查询位置作用不同
sections.en: The setup wizard separates the tracked URL, country for default metrics, depth/frequency, keywords and search-engine configurations. Each engine has its own country, device, language, search type and optional custom location. The local-map business name must match its actual full name. Saved engine monitoring preferences cannot be edited by the user according to this guide; changes require support. Editorial first project: verify one representative configuration and its expected result before multiplying markets. Keywords/imports can be reused, but defaults do not establish the correct local audience or collection scope.
sections.zh: 设置向导区分跟踪 URL、默认指标国家、深度／频率、关键词及搜索引擎配置。各引擎独立国家、设备、语言、搜索类型及可选定制位置；地图商家名需匹配真实全名。该指南说已存引擎监控偏好不能由用户编辑，变更需支持。编辑首项目：扩展市场前核一个代表配置及预期结果。关键词／导入可复用，但默认不能确定正确本地受众或采集范围。

sections.title_en: A weekly unit baseline changes with frequency and engine type
sections.title_zh: 周更单位基线随频率及引擎改变
sections.en: A base unit is one keyword on one engine/location/device, weekly, at up to five pages. Daily multiplies by seven, ten-page depth by two, and AIO/AI Mode by two. Scheduled work reserves units; partial/on-demand checks consume them until the billing-month reset. Removing scheduled work releases its reservation. Brand Intelligence instead counts topics, LLMs and runs, with a higher web-search multiplier. Editorial example: 100 terms on two standard devices, daily, at five pages need 1,400 units. Inspect Resources before expanding; headline capacity does not mean unlimited daily checks.
sections.zh: 基准单位为一个词、一个引擎／位置／设备、周更、最多五页。日更乘七，十页乘二，AIO／AI Mode 乘二。定时工作预留单位，partial／按需消耗到计费月重置，移除定时工作释放预留。Brand Intelligence 另按主题、LLM 及运行次数，web search 倍率更高。编辑例：100 词、两个标准设备、日更、五页需 1,400 单位。扩展前查 Resources，标题容量不代表不限日更。

sections.title_en: A start log is not completion evidence
sections.title_zh: 启动日志不能证明完成
sections.en: Initial collection can take minutes or hours; the completed progress stages and loaded results confirm finish. Choosing Paused prevents the new project’s initial collection. Partial updates cover newly added terms/engines, not a refresh of existing terms; on-demand updates refresh existing work with different delivery windows. Resources shows completion separately from Activity Log start events. A paused project can still have an independent scheduled on-demand task. Editorial stale-report check: inspect last/next update and actual Resources status before starting another job, and inspect both schedulers before assuming Pause stops every collection path.
sections.zh: 首次采集可需分钟或小时，阶段完成及结果加载才证明结束。选择 Paused 阻止新项目首次采集。Partial 只覆盖新增词／引擎，不刷新已有词；按需以不同交付窗口刷新已有工作。Resources 的完成状态独立于 Activity Log 启动事件。暂停项目仍可有独立定时按需任务。编辑旧报告检查：重启任务前查最近／下次更新及真实 Resources 状态，不能仅据 Pause 假设全部采集路径停止，需查两类调度。

sections.title_en: A rank snapshot is not the same as a browser search or GSC aggregate
sections.title_zh: 排名快照不同于浏览搜索或 GSC 汇总
sections.en: The comparison guide attributes discrepancies to configured result counting, location, timing and personalization. AWR’s Universal and Organic definitions count different SERP elements; even a nearby manual search can use a different location or moment. Its collection may precede displayed delivery time. Editorial discrepancy check: match keyword, device, location, language and search definition, then inspect the retrieved SERP and an appropriate GSC view. Do not force an exact one-to-one match or adopt the vendor’s absolute accuracy claim as a test result. An unexplained difference should remain an investigation, not an automatic penalty or data-error diagnosis.
sections.zh: 比较指南将差异归于结果计数配置、位置、时间及个性化。AWR Universal 与 Organic 计入不同 SERP 元素，附近手搜也可位置／时刻不同，采集可能早于显示交付。编辑差异检查：匹配词、设备、位置、语言及搜索定义，再看所取 SERP 及相应 GSC 视图。不能强求一对一相同，也不能将供应商绝对准确主张当测试结果。不明差异应继续调查，不能自动诊断为惩罚或数据错。

sections.title_en: Cluster opportunity is a scoped snapshot, not a traffic promise
sections.title_zh: 聚类机会是限定范围快照，不是流量承诺
sections.en: Keyword Clusters uses overlapping top Google URLs, computed across the project from one eligible engine shown in its scope. It recomputes after updates; the selected range displays the latest snapshot and compares the prior update. Pro is excluded. Unclustered terms remain separate, while uncovered clusters have no identified ranking page. Combined volume counts overlapping phrases in full, so it is not unique demand or a traffic forecast. Editorial content planning: inspect common URLs, mixed intent and existing site pages before deciding one new page serves the cluster; several ranking pages alone do not justify deleting them.
sections.zh: Keyword Clusters 按顶部 Google URL 重叠，在项目的一个合格引擎计算并显示范围；每次更新重算，所选区间呈最新快照并比前次。Pro 排除。未聚类词独立，未覆盖聚类未找到排名页。总量完整计入重叠词，不是唯一需求或流量预测。编辑内容规划：决定一页覆盖聚类前查看共同 URL、混合意图及已有站点页；多页排名本身不足以支持删页。

sections.title_en: Brand mention tracking differs from topic perception research
sections.title_zh: 品牌提及跟踪不同于主题认知研究
sections.en: AWR distinguishes plain-text brand references from linked citations to specific pages. Without configured brand references, the guide warns that unlinked mentions may be missed. A citation shown in an answer does not independently establish training provenance, endorsement or a click. AI Search tracks changes for the selected query/engine panel; Brand Intelligence explores associated topics, co-occurring brands and sources, with market/language context. Editorial AI readout: preserve brand aliases, query, engine and date, inspect the actual answer, and report mentions, citations and measured referrals separately. Platform coverage is not identical for every market or workflow.
sections.zh: AWR 区分纯文字品牌提及及具体页面链接引用；指南提醒未配品牌引用词可漏无链接提及。回答出现引用不能独立确定训练来源、背书或点击。AI Search 跟踪所选查询／引擎面板变化，Brand Intelligence 探索相关主题、同现品牌及来源，并含市场／语言上下文。编辑 AI 报告：保留品牌别名、查询、引擎及日期，查看真实回答，分别报告提及、引用及实测引荐。各市场／流程平台覆盖不完全相同。

sections.title_en: Interactive share links still expose read-only project data
sections.title_zh: 交互分享链接仍是项目数据只读访问
sections.en: An Owner/Admin creates a permalink for selected project reports, including SERP HTML and export access. View Only permits date changes; Interactive additionally changes displayed website, keyword, engine, filters and columns. These are report interactions, not edits to the tracked project. The same URL updates as collection completes and can be disabled/reset; multiple projects can be included. Editorial client delivery: inspect sections and interactive scope with the intended client view before sharing. A displayed filter is not a frozen report, and a recipient can export the data made available. Password/expiry controls were not established.
sections.zh: Owner／Admin 为所选项目报告创建永久链接，含 SERP HTML 及导出。View Only 可改日期，Interactive 另可改显示网站、词、引擎、筛选及列；这是报告交互，不是修改跟踪项目。同一 URL 随采集更新，可禁用／重置并含多项目。编辑客户交付：分享前以客户视图检查部分及交互范围；显示筛选不等于冻结报告，收件人能导出获授数据。未确定密码／到期控制。

sections.title_en: Use effective permissions rather than the old role summary
sections.title_zh: 使用实际权限，不能只看旧角色摘要
sections.en: The current Custom-role guide says Team Members edit assigned projects but cannot create/delete projects; the older User Management page says they can. It also differs on Admin branding access. Custom permissions are available on Agency monthly and all yearly plans, and can control project operations, integrations, billing/resources and user management. Owner/Admin changes each user’s permissions individually after invitation. Editorial agency setup: check the effective project list and permission switches before inviting a collaborator. Unlimited seats do not establish uniform access, and the published conflict was not resolved through an account-level test.
sections.zh: 当前 Custom 指南说 Team Member 可编辑分配项目但不能创建／删除，旧 User Management 却说可以，Admin 品牌设置访问也不同。Custom 权限适用 Agency 月付及全部年付，可控项目、集成、账单／资源及成员管理；Owner／Admin 邀请后逐人调整。编辑机构设置：邀请协作者前查真实项目表及权限开关。不限席位不代表相同访问，未通过账户测试解决公开冲突。

sections.title_en: Report scheduling and language do not follow every viewer
sections.title_zh: 报告调度及语言不跟随每位查看者
sections.en: A PDF scheduler selects projects, recipients and cadence; Active/Stopped controls delivery independently of rank collection. Drive upload is separately enabled after connecting Drive. The language guide lists nineteen interface languages chosen per user. Shared links and scheduled PDFs use the account owner’s language; notification emails remain English. API/MCP fields and key export text stay unchanged, while a personal report-generation timezone is separate. Editorial multilingual client report: verify output language, timezone, selected projects and recipients rather than assuming a teammate’s UI language transforms tracking queries or every exported file.
sections.zh: PDF 调度选择项目、收件人及周期，Active／Stopped 独立于排名采集控制投递，连接 Drive 后另开上传。语言指南列十九种界面语言，每人自选；分享链接及定时 PDF 用账户所有者语言，通知邮件仍英文。API／MCP 字段及关键导出文字不变，个人报告生成时区独立。编辑多语客户报告：核输出语言、时区、项目及收件人，不能假设同事 UI 语言改变跟踪查询或全部导出文件。

sections.title_en: MCP reads the configured panel rather than proving causation
sections.title_zh: MCP 读取配置面板，不证明因果
sections.en: The remote MCP guide describes a consent flow, a dedicated MCP-scoped key and revocation. Its tools retrieve project settings, updates, ranks, SERPs, modeled traffic and AI visibility for analysis. The detailed guide states Agency and above, while the units guide’s all-plan summary also lists MCP; eligibility therefore needs the actual account plan. Editorial automation: ask for available update dates and exact engine/keyword scope before a trend narrative, and retain the underlying data. An assistant can summarize a correlation but does not establish that a content change caused rankings or revenue. No connector was authorized here.
sections.zh: 远程 MCP 指南描述同意流程、专用 MCP 范围 key 及撤销。工具读取项目设置、更新、排名、SERP、模型流量及 AI 可见性。详细指南列 Agency 以上，单位指南的全部档摘要却也列 MCP，因此资格需核真实账户档。编辑自动化：叙述趋势前先问可用更新日期及准确引擎／词范围，并保留底层数据。代理能汇总相关，不能确定内容变化造成排名或收入，本研究未授权连接器。

sections.title_en: Subscription pause resumes with a charge
sections.title_zh: 订阅暂停在恢复时扣费
sections.en: The subscription-pause guide applies only to monthly paid accounts and says pause is available once. It starts at the end of the current billing month for seven days, one month or three months; history/report access remains but rank/difficulty checks stop. Automatic or early manual resumption starts a new billed cycle. This differs from pausing a project schedule or stopping a report email. Pricing separately says cancellation preserves paid-period access, then disables functions, later login, and eventually data. Editorial exit: agree on the intended billing outcome, export needed history and confirm actual dates before leaving a client panel inactive.
sections.zh: 订阅暂停指南仅适用月付账户，称只能使用一次，在当前计费月末起暂停七天、一个月或三个月；保留历史／报告但停排名／难度检查。自动或提前手动恢复开始新付费周期，不同于暂停项目计划或报告邮件。价格页另说取消保留已付期访问，之后先禁功能、再禁登录、最终删数据。编辑退出：明确预期账单结果，导所需历史，搁置客户面板前核真实日期。

seo.title_zh: Advanced Web Ranking：关键词单位、更新状态及 AI 报告

research_gaps.zh: 不同帮助版的 Team Member 创建／删除及 Admin 品牌设置权限冲突，未操作真实强制权限。

research_gaps.zh: MCP 全档摘要与详细 Agency+ 指南冲突，单位表及年付权益需当前账户确认，标准化价／币种代码未知。

research_gaps.en: Full AI engine/country coverage, topic/web-search costs, report-link security, exact billing/deletion timeline and source-code licence not fully verified.
research_gaps.zh: 完整 AI 引擎／国家覆盖、主题／web search 成本、报告链接安全、准确账单／删除时间及源码许可未完整核。

research_gaps.en: No signup, paid order, data connection, ranking update, AI query, forecast, export, invitation or report email executed; accuracy and customer outcomes unmeasured.
research_gaps.zh: 未注册、购买、连数据、排名更新、AI 查询、预测、导出、邀请或报告邮件，准确率及客户效果未测。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation. Examples and fit judgments are editorial, not executed tests.
